questions.question: Which five-year plan was based on the ideas of Mahalanobis?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Second five-year plan**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Second Five-Year Plan:

 
• The focus of the second five-year plan was heavy industries.
 
• Rapid industrialization was used to set a goal of a 25% rise in national income.
 
• The Mahalanobis model is used in the second five-year plan. PC Mahalanobis, the founder of the Indian Statistical Institute and a close aide of Nehru, Indianized the USSR model.
 
• Through an elaborate input-output model, this approach is known to have provided the statistical foundations for state-directed investments and created the intellectual underpinnings of the licensing raj.
 
• This concept was used to establish India's second five-year plan and the Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956, which cleared the way for the rise of the public sector and the license raj.
 
• The growth target was 4.50% but achieved 4.27%.

Achievements of Second Five-Year Plan:

 
• ​In the second five-year plan, steel mills were built in Bhilai, Durgapur, and Rourkela.
 
• This plan included increased coal production and the addition of extra railway lines.
 
• Homi J. Bhabha was the first head of the Atomic Energy Commission, which was established in 1948.
 
• As a research institute, the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research was founded.
 
• A talent search and scholarship program was started in 1957 to locate exceptional young students who could be trained for the nuclear power industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50aeb211c43f6f054267a83d1cf336dfac21a673cacd5421aea3f05c80de5fc.png]

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are NOT correct?

I. Force per unit volume is called pressure.

II. Liquids can exert pressure on walls of containers.

III. Force acting on an object can cause a change in it state of motion but not its shape.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Only I and III**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Force acting on a unit area is called pressure.
 
• The pressure increases with increasing depth.
 
• This is due to the water up above weighing down on the water below.
 
• Liquid pressure increases as depth increases.
 
• The pressure is greater on the lower surfaces of the body than on the upper surfaces as the pressure in a fluid increases with depth.
 
• Pressure and depth are directly proportional to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The pressure at sea level is taken as the standard atmospheric pressure.
 
• As the height increases from sea level, the atmospheric pressure decreases.
 
• At high altitudes where atmospheric pressure is less, it bleeds from the nose due to high blood pressure.
 
• SI unit of pressure is the Pascal.

questions.question: The Mahanadi basin does not extend over which state?

__
 
• T**he Mahanadi basin** extends over the states of **Chhattisgarh and Odisha and smaller portions of Jharkhand, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• It drains an** area of** **1,41,589 Sq.km **which is nearly 4.3% of the total geographical area of the country.
 
• The geographical extent of the basin lies between** 80°28’ and 86°43’ east longitudes and 19°8’ and 23°32’ north latitudes.**
 
• The basin has a maximum length and width of 587 km and 400 km.
 
• It is bounded by the Central India hills on the north, by the Eastern Ghats on the south and east and by the Maikala range on the west. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

• The total length of the river from origin to its outfall into the Bay of Bengal is** 851 km.**
 
• The major part of the basin is covered with agricultural land accounting to 54.27% of the total area and 4.45% of the basin is covered by water bodies.
 
• **The basin spreads over 27 parliamentary constituencies** comprising 13 of Odisha, 11 of Chhattisgarh, and 1 each of Maharashtra, Jharkhand and Madhya Pradesh.

These performance categories provide a comprehensive assessment of the logistics infrastructure and services across different states and UTs, highlighting the achievements and areas for improvement in the logistics sector.

questions.question: A ______ account is one which is maintained by an Indian Bank in the foreign countries usually in the currency of that country for the purpose of carrying out transactions there.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **NOSTRO account **is a foreign bank account that an Indian bank maintains in a foreign currency in a foreign country.
 
• The term **"NOSTRO"** comes from the Latin phrase **"Nostro Recipiente,"** which means** "our account with you"**.
 
• "The purpose of maintaining a **NOSTRO account** is to facilitate foreign transactions.
 
• For example,** if an Indian company wants to import goods from a foreign country, it can use its NOSTRO account to pay the foreign supplier in the supplier's local currency.**
 
• Similarly, if an Indian company has received payment for its exports in a foreign currency, it can receive the payment in its **NOSTRO account.**
 
• Overall, **NOSTRO accounts** are used by banks to facilitate international trade and commerce by providing a mechanism for settling cross-border transactions in the currency of the foreign country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **VOSTRO - **

 
 
• 
 
A **VOSTRO account **is the opposite of a **NOSTRO account.**

 
 
• 
 
While a **NOSTRO account** is a foreign bank account that an Indian bank maintains in a foreign country, a **VOSTRO account** is an Indian bank account that a foreign bank** maintains in India**.

 
 
• 
 
The term** "VOSTRO" **comes from the Latin phrase **"Vostro Recipiente," **which means "your account with us.**"Foreign banks maintain VOSTRO accounts in India to facilitate their operations in the country.**

 
 
• 
 
For example, a foreign bank may maintain a** VOSTRO account** with an Indian bank to receive and make payments in Indian Rupees on behalf of its clients who are conducting business in India.

 
 
• 
 
Overall,** VOSTRO** accounts are used by foreign banks to facilitate their operations in India, allowing them to receive and make payments in Indian Rupees and providing a mechanism for settling transactions in the local currency.

 
 
 
 
• **LIBOR -**
 
 
• 
 
**LIBOR **stands for the London Interbank Offered Rate. It is the benchmark interest rate that is used as a reference for various financial instruments such as loans, derivatives, and bonds in the international financial markets.

 
 
• 
 
**LIBOR** is calculated based on the average interest rates that a panel of banks in London offer each other for short-term loans in different currencies and different maturities.

 
 
• 
 
The rate is published daily by the** ICE Benchmark Administration,** and it is used as a reference rate for trillions of dollars worth of financial contracts worldwide.

 
 
• 
 
However, the use of** LIBOR** has been under scrutiny since the 2008 financial crisis, when some banks were found to have manipulated the rate for their own benefit.

 
 
• 
 
As a result, in** 2017**, the UK Financial Conduct Authority announced that it would phase out LIBOR by the end of 2021, and encourage market participants to transition to alternative reference rates. In summary, LIBOR is a widely used benchmark interest rate that is being phased out due to concerns about its reliability and potential for manipulation.

 
 
 

 

 
• **MIBOR - **

 
• 
 
MIBOR stands for the Mumbai Interbank Offered Rate. It is the benchmark interest rate that is used in the Indian financial markets as a reference for various financial instruments such as loans, derivatives, and bonds.

 
 
• 
 
MIBOR is calculated based on the average interest rates that a panel of banks in Mumbai offer each other for short-term loans in the Indian money market.

 
 
• 
 
The rate is published by the National Stock Exchange of India and is used as a reference rate for financial contracts in the Indian market.

 
 
• 
 
MIBOR is calculated for different maturities ranging from overnight to one year, and it is used as a benchmark for determining the interest rates on various financial products such as loans, floating-rate bonds, and interest rate swaps.

 
 
• 
 
It is an important benchmark for the Indian financial markets and is closely watched by market participants and regulators.

 
 
• 
 
In summary, MIBOR is the benchmark interest rate for the Indian financial markets that is used as a reference for various financial products and is calculated based on the average interest rates offered by a panel of banks in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which of the following disease is not caused by a mosquito bite?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Hepatitis is a viral infection that affects the liver and can cause inflammation and damage to the liver.**
 
• There are different types of hepatitis viruses, such as hepatitis **A, B, C, D, and E,** and each is transmitted in different ways.
 
• **Hepatitis A and E** are usually transmitted through contaminated food or water, and they do not cause chronic liver disease.
 
• Hepatitis** B, C, and D** are transmitted through infected **blood or body fluids, and they can cause chronic liver disease and lead to liver failure or liver cancer.**
 
• **Mosquitoes, **on the other hand, are known to transmit various diseases such as malaria, dengue fever, Zika virus, and yellow fever, but they do not transmit hepatitis viruses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Elephantiasis** is a parasitic infection that is transmitted by mosquitoes and causes chronic swelling and enlargement of body parts due to damage to the lymphatic system.

 
 
• It can be prevented through measures such as mosquito control and proper treatment of infected individuals.
 
 
 
• **Dengue** is a viral infection that is transmitted to humans by infected mosquitoes, primarily the Aedes aegypti mosquito.
 
 
• It is a common mosquito-borne disease that is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions of the world.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Malaria** is a serious and sometimes fatal disease caused by a parasite called Plasmodium, which is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.

 
 
• 
 
Malaria is most prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions of the world, including many countries in Africa, Asia, and the Americas.

• ** A barcode reader is not an output device.**
 
• It is actually an **input device**, which is used to **read and interpret data from barcode labels and transmit that data to a computer or other device.**
 
• Barcode readers use optical scanning technology to read the pattern of bars and spaces on a barcode label, which represents a specific code or series of numbers and characters.
 
• This information is then sent to a computer or other device for processing and interpretation.
 
• Output devices, on the other hand, are devices that are used to display or transmit information or data from a computer or other device.
 
• Examples of output devices include computer monitors, printers, speakers, and projectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** A plotter **is a type of **output device** that is used to print **large-scale graphics, designs, and technical drawings.**

 
 
• Unlike traditional printers, which use ink or toner to create** images on paper, plotters use a pen or other marking instrument to draw precise lines and shapes on paper, vinyl, or other materials.**
 
 
 
• **​A monitor** is an output device that displays visual information from a computer or other electronic device. Also referred to as a computer screen or display screen, a monitor is one of the most important components of a computer system.
 
• 
 
**A dot matrix printer** is a type of impact printer that uses a matrix of **small pins to strike an inked ribbon and create an image or text on paper**.

 
 
• 
 
The pins are arranged in a grid, and when the printer head moves across the page, the pins strike the ribbon and transfer ink onto the paper, creating a series of dots that form characters and images.

questions.question: In the higher latitudes (50° - 70°) of Northern hemisphere the spectacular Coniferous forests are found. These are also called as ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Coniferous forests found in the higher latitudes (50° - 70°) of Northern Hemisphere are also called Boreal forests or Taiga.**
 
• They are characterized by a cold and harsh climate,** with long, cold winters and short, cool summers.**
 
• The dominant tree species in these forests are conifers such as **spruce, pine, and fir,** which are adapted to the harsh climate and poor soil conditions.
 
• The Boreal forest is an important ecosystem, providing habitat for a wide range of wildlife and playing a crucial role in global carbon cycling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Veld -**

 
 
• Veld is a term used to describe open grassland areas found in** Southern Africa,** especially in **South Africa, Botswana, Zimbabwe, and Namibia.**
 
• These regions are characterized by a **semi-arid to arid climate with dry, hot summers and cool, dry winters.**
 
• The vegetation in the veld varies from** grassland **to** savanna** with scattered **trees and shrubs.**
 
• The grasses in the veld are adapted to withstand drought and fire, and are often grazed by large herbivores such as antelopes and zebras.
 
• The veld is an important ecosystem for biodiversity, supporting a wide range of animal and plant species, including many endemic and threatened species.
 
• It is also used for livestock grazing and agriculture, making it an important economic resource for the region.
 
 
 
• **Tundra -**
 
 
• Tundra is a type of biome characterized by its **low temperatures, short growing season, and lack of trees.**
 
• It is found in the Arctic and Alpine regions, where the ground is frozen for much of the year (permafrost) and the climate is **harsh and cold.**
 
• The tundra is covered in low-lying vegetation, including mosses, lichens, grasses, and small shrubs, and is home to a variety of animal species such as **caribou, musk oxen, Arctic foxes, and polar bears.**
 
• Due to its extreme environment, the tundra is a fragile ecosystem that is particularly vulnerable to human activities such as **oil and gas exploration, mining, and climate change.**
 
• It is also an important carbon sink, helping to regulate the Earth's climate by storing large amounts of carbon in its** frozen soil.**
 
 
 
• **​The** **Llanos** -
 
 
• The Llanos, also known as Los Llanos, is a vast tropical grassland plain located in South America, primarily in Venezuela and Colombia.
 
• The region is characterized by its flat terrain, with grassy plains that are often flooded during the rainy season and dry and dusty during the dry season.
 
• The Llanos is home to a diverse array of wildlife, including capybaras, anacondas, jaguars, giant anteaters, and many species of birds.
 
• The grasslands also support large numbers of domesticated animals, such as cattle and horses, and are an important agricultural region for both countries.
 
• The Llanos is also a popular destination for ecotourism, with visitors coming to observe wildlife and experience the traditional cowboy culture of the region.
